findings.source_passage: more wrinkles than an unsettled pond. His soft blue eyes smiled at Stephanie.
findings.source_locator: paragraph describing Jethro, after the golden-cloaked figure removes his hood
findings.why_it_matters: The simile 'more wrinkles than an unsettled pond' is a stylistically distinctive, voice-establishing comic figure that characterises Mac Flynn's narrator; its removal flattens a key moment of tonal register.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the simile: 'He was about seventy with more wrinkles than an unsettled pond. His soft blue eyes smiled at Stephanie.'

findings.source_passage: I shook my head. 'Never mind. Just don't drop me.' He chuckled. 'I believe I can agree to your request.'
findings.why_it_matters: In the source the dialogue is tagged with full beats (she shakes her head; he chuckles) that carry the light, ironic tone. The draft strips the action tags, reducing it to bare speech and losing the rhythm that signals the narrator's voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-add 'He chuckled.' before his agreement line and 'I shook my head.' before 'Never mind,' to restore the comic beat.

findings.source_passage: Jethro. 'I have not seen the likes of her in many years.' Stephanie blushed and looked at the ground. Cayden bowed. 'Thank you, Jethro. I, too, am most pleased with her.'
findings.source_locator: After Jethro removes his hood, through Cayden's reply
findings.why_it_matters: Jethro's compliment and Stephanie's blushing reaction, followed by Cayden's formal pleasure, form a small social comedy that also establishes the Maiden's value and Cayden's proprietorial satisfaction. Its removal deletes characterisation for both Stephanie and Cayden.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Jethro's full speech, Stephanie's blush, and Cayden's reply before Xander's 'But to the reason for our visit' redirect.

findings.source_passage: A cool wind whipped my hair over my face and over my bare arms. The warmth of the dragon lord's body stifled some of my shivering.
findings.source_locator: Second descriptive paragraph of the flight, after the first dialogue exchange
findings.why_it_matters: The physical detail of bare arms and the dragon lord's warmth establishes the heroine's vulnerability and closeness to Xander; omitting it thins the sensory grounding of the opening flight.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a sentence noting the wind on her hair and bare arms and the warmth stifling her shivering during the flight description.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; the draft faithfully carries all major plot beats and most distinctive passages, but drops Jethro's comic wrinkle-simile, the Stephanie-blush social exchange, and a handful of beat-tags that carry the narrator's light ironic register — two medium and two low findings, below the regeneration threshold.
